name: app-doctor-booking-app-pinched-by-dark-hand-on-grey
title: Doctor Booking App Held Between Fingers
whatItIs: A minimal cover on flat grey with a dark hand holding a phone from below, showing a doctor-finder home with a booking card and pastel specialty cards.
whatItMeans: A single hand on neutral grey makes the phone look like a simple, approachable tool.
techniques: Flat grey backdrop with the hand entering from the bottom
Small phone centred with generous space
Pastel green and blue cards for categories
Black primary button for the main action

vocabulary.definition: A card for a category of doctor or service.
A hand entering the frame from the bottom edge.
